passage.label: Al-Baqarah — believe in confirming revelation; do not sell signs; establish prayer; fear the Day

arabicExcerpts.text: وَءَامِنُواْ بِمَآ أَنزَلۡتُ مُصَدِّقٗا لِّمَا مَعَكُمۡ وَلَا تَكُونُوٓاْ أَوَّلَ كَافِرِۭ بِهِۦۖ وَلَا تَشۡتَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِي ثَمَنٗا قَلِيلٗا وَإِيَّـٰيَ فَٱتَّقُونِ
وَلَا تَلۡبِسُواْ ٱلۡحَقَّ بِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ وَتَكۡتُمُواْ ٱلۡحَقَّ وَأَنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱرۡكَعُواْ مَعَ ٱلرَّـٰكِعِينَ
۞أَتَأۡمُرُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ بِٱلۡبِرِّ وَتَنسَوۡنَ أَنفُسَكُمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ تَتۡلُونَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ
وَٱسۡتَعِينُواْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِۚ وَإِنَّهَا لَكَبِيرَةٌ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلۡخَٰشِعِينَ
ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَٰقُواْ رَبِّهِمۡ وَأَنَّهُمۡ إِلَيۡهِ رَٰجِعُونَ
يَٰبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ ٱذۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَتِيَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَأَنِّي فَضَّلۡتُكُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
وَٱتَّقُواْ يَوۡمٗا لَّا تَجۡزِي نَفۡسٌ عَن نَّفۡسٖ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا يُقۡبَلُ مِنۡهَا شَفَٰعَةٞ وَلَا يُؤۡخَذُ مِنۡهَا عَدۡلٞ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ

mainSubject.label: Command to believe in confirming revelation; prohibition against selling signs for small price; establishing prayer and zakah; warning against mixing truth with falsehood; seeking help through patience and prayer; certainty of meeting Lord; remembrance of favor upon Bani Israel; fear of the Day of Judgment

subordinateSubjects.label: Command to believe in what Allah sent down confirming existing scripture
Prohibition against being first to disbelieve in the confirming revelation
Prohibition against exchanging Allah's signs for a small price
Prohibition against mixing truth with falsehood
Prohibition against concealing truth while knowing it
Command to bow with those who bow
Rebuke: ordering righteousness for others while forgetting yourselves
Reciting the Scripture yet failing to reason
Seeking help through patience and prayer
Prayer/patience is difficult except for the humbly submissive (khashi'een)
Certainty of meeting their Lord and returning to Him
Address to Bani Israel: remember My favor and preference over the worlds
Fear a Day when no soul suffices for another
No intercession accepted, no compensation taken, no aid on that Day

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Knowledge of truth yet concealing it as moral failure
Hypocrisy: commanding good for others while neglecting self
Khushoo' (humble submission) as prerequisite for patience/prayer
Certainty (yaqeen) of meeting Lord and return

socialEconomicCivilisational.label: Selling divine signs for worldly gain as economic-spiritual corruption

relationships.label: Covenantal address to Bani Israel recalling divine preference

notes: Pass A pilot 4, passage 8/3. Contains transition from general commands to Bani Israel-specific discourse. First occurrence of ista'eenoo bis-sabr (seek help through patience).
